stock.description: Kontafarma China Holdings Ltd. directs its business efforts through two principal segments: Pharmaceutical and Fitness. Its Pharmaceutical arm is responsible for the manufacturing and marketing of prescription medications and associated laboratory goods. Meanwhile, the Fitness division oversees the management of health clubs, delivers advisory services for physical well-being and health-related pursuits, and runs a franchise model to generate royalty revenue. Established on March 21, 2011, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Hong Kong.
